title: Theatre Review: The Cost Of Living

body_presentation.source_prefix:
THEATRE REVIEW THE COST OF LIVING

Thursday, April 09, 1992

ROBERT CUSHMAN

Toronto ONT -- WRITTEN BY MORRIS PANYCH Starring Tim Battle At Young People's Theatre Rating: AIDS message is in the medium Morris Panych's, The Cost of Living is a brilliant and cleverly disguised lecture on AIDS using banks of video monitors to reach its teen audience BY ROBERT CUSHMAN Special to The Globe and Mail Toronto THE Cost of Living is a brilliant play about growing up - brilliant in both writing and performance - disguised as a lecture on AIDS awareness. Or maybe it's the other way round.
